_doc: Equal footing in matches (docs/decisions/0005-equal-footing.md; scripts/match/equal.gd). What a hunter may bring from home: gloves, boots and utility. rarity_cap_by_tier: the highest rarity (0 Common .. 4 Legendary) a brought piece keeps, by difficulty tier (Data.TIERS: The Meadow, Dusk Isles, The Hollow). issue: the belt charges every hunter is given. util_drops: chance that a table (GearDrops tables, by name; _default for any other) also drops one utility item, and how many charges. migration: the v5 to v6 save conversion of armour and kit pieces (gems = item value x gem_k; materials = gear.json extract_mats by rarity); a bought backpack level becomes that backpack, and the levels below it are refunded. base_pack: backpack slots everyone has (the Pouch). backpacks: the tiers (Backpacks), the slots each adds on top of base_pack and its armory price [gems, scrap]. backpack_cap_by_tier: the biggest tier that may be brought, by difficulty tier. backpack_shop: run gems a shop upgrade to that tier costs. bot_backpack: chance a bot sets out with a bigger backpack than the Pouch.
